purpose: THE authoritative log of every out-of-sample dataset open in this repository. Future agents MUST consult this log before opening any OOS data. Duplicate OOS use (same candidate identity re-opening a consumed window) must fail closed. The sealed holdout partition (2017-12-01 to 2018-01-01 UTC, HistData 2017) has NEVER been opened by any recorded event and must remain sealed unless a future governance mission explicitly unseals it with a new preregistration.
fail_closed_rules: Before any OOS evaluation, the runner must verify the candidate identity is absent from this log for the target dataset+window, or must STOP with OOS_ALREADY_CONSUMED.

A window consumed by candidate X may be opened by a DIFFERENT preregistered candidate Y only with an explicit preregistration that acknowledges the prior consumption (data reuse is disclosed, never hidden).
The SEALED_HOLDOUT window of any dataset may only be opened by an explicit governance mission that amends this log's holdout policy first.
Events are append-only. No event may be edited or deleted; corrections add a new event referencing the old one.
